d:
A crystalline scorpion-like species with a segmented exoskeleton. Glowing turquoise eyes set into a hard, chitinous face. Massive, multi-legged build with a heavy, armored carapace in deep teal and obsidian black. Features a large, curved stinger tail and two heavy crushing claws. Four legs on the main body with three claws per limb.
BODY COLOR: Deep teal
